notes.title: Free to Play Announcement
notes.content:
Blade of Acrimony will become free to play.
Due to level of experience that I have now, I don't feel that it's right to ask for payment.
This change will occur as soon as valve updates it.

notes.title: Blade of Acrimony V 1.41 Update
notes.content:
Just a smol update.

[list]
[*] Fixed some spelling/grammar errors.
[*] Added a helpful save spot.
[*] Fixed an end game music bug
[/list]

notes.title: Blade of Acrimony V 1.4 Update
notes.content:
[u]Super important battle update time![/u]

[list]
[*] --Sora get's a new skill at LV 15:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34127709/b97d685a5ab6637e6b42e57573dabff33dc31de0.png[/img]

Thunder Whirl:
A powerful electric attack that numbs the target!
Can't be countered, but can be parried! 
Cost 35DP, and will cause paralysis for 1-2 turns 100% of the time.

[*] --Sora's tragedy skills have been buffed.
[*] --Some dialog/spelling/plot holes fixes.
[*] --A new graphic for the stupid old ship. 
[*] --A message before the first boss about eating souls.
[/list]

Note: Old saves won't work with the new update, sorry about that...

notes.title: Blade of Acrimony V 1.3 Update
notes.content:
You know the drill, it's update time!

[list]
[*] --Shawn and Hazel's encounter puzzle is obvious now.
[*] --Luna's 1 hit kill first move is now telegraphed.
[*] --The final boss's DP drain move is less powerful.
[*] --Blocking now boosts your DP by 10 instead of 5.
[*] --Some spelling fixes and a plot hole resolved.
[*] --A weird bug with the final boss.
[/list]

notes.title: Blade of Acrimony V 1.2 Update
notes.content:
Don't worry, I didn't break the game this time.

--Most encounters have their evade rates lowered, or removed all together.
--The Superboss has different music, for plot/lore reasons.
--A weird UI glitch that I may have caused with the first update is fixed.

notes.title: World is saved! Update is fixed!
notes.content: I just fixed the updated version, the game is now stable and ready to go. Sorry for the wait.

notes.title: The Update that destroyed everything!
notes.content:
[b]The game is currently in a broken state because of an update.[/b]

Don't update Blade of Acrimony if asked.

If you want to buy the game, please buy it somewhere else for the time being!

I have emailed steam help so I can have this fixed [b]ASAP[/b]!


Sorry for any inconveniences this my have caused.
